messages:
marta: Heads-up — Support escalated a customer incident: repeated 5xx + long-tail latency on /v1/infer (hosted-usw2). SLO alert fired for p99. Ticket #4248.
support-ops: customer saw 502 then timeouts, they say it started ~03:20 UTC. p50 looks fine, p99 is brutal.
jia: seeing the same alert. On the dashboard probe vs real-traffic diverged at 03:18 — probes steady, real traffic p99 jumped.
marta: tracing gaps for the window, spans missing between gateway -> modelpool. Suspect handshake/backpressure stall. sre-bot: https://console.redwood/slo/alerts/1769999999 (alert details).
sre-bot: Alert: hosted-infer-usw2 p99 > 2500ms for 10m. Traces sampled: 12% of requests. Correlation flagged with auth-service latency.
paul: quick query please: gateway errors around handshake. Try: `level=error service=gateway component=inference "handshake" | count() by upstream_host`
jia: ran it against 03:10-03:30 window — multiple "handshake timeout" to modelpool-3 and modelpool-7 around 03:17-03:22. snippet:
```
2026-03-16T03:18:12Z ERROR handshake timeout id=abc upstream=modelpool-7 conn=xyz
```
marta: any auth 401/403 spike? If token validation is slow gateway holds connections and we can see cascading backpressure.
jia: auth service p95 jumped at same time. Billing KV lookups show p95 ~1.8s at 03:17. Query: `service=auth | p95(duration) by minute`
paul: so chain looks like auth -> billing-kv > 1s -> gateway holds -> modelpool backlog -> handshake timeouts => 502s. Customer also said they were sending long-context batches which probably made the backlog worse.
support-ops: customer confirms their requests were larger than usual. Impacted ~10% of their calls during window.
marta: mitigations proposed: (A) enable auth cache TTL bump (short-term) to avoid KV lookups, (B) scale modelpool replicas in-usw2, (C) consider rollback of recent billing-kv change if we can. Thoughts?
jia: I can patch auth-service for a short-circuit: if KV lookup exceeds 500ms, use last-known token state (best-effort) and log. Will PR to canary.
paul: infra: @kevin can you add 2 modelpool replicas in usw2 to soak backlog? Also create an alert for handshake timeout rate > 0.5%.
kevin: infra-ops here — spinning up 2 replicas now, ETA ~4m.
marta: PR link (auth): https://git/repo/auth/pull/1234 — includes rollout + rollback notes. Jia, assign canary at 10% first.
jia: merged and rolled to 10% canary. Early metrics: handshake timeouts down ~30% in canary slice.
paul: temporary alert created: name=hosted-infer-handshake-rate-usw2 threshold=0.5% window=5m. Page if fired.
support-ops: updated customer — they saw fewer errors after our interventions but still intermittent timeouts. They're appreciative of the quick responses.
marta: next steps: 1) enable auth cache globally if canary looks good, 2) run customer workload replay in staging with long-context batches to repro, 3) prepare RCA if billing-kv change is root cause. I'll own postmortem.
jia: for observability improvements: enable 100% trace sampling for /v1/infer for next 1h in us-west-2 and add a probe that mimics long-context handshake. Also adding a dashboard panel for handshake queue depth.
kevin: new modelpool replicas are up. Monitoring GPU/handshake queues now.
paul: useful queries saved for follow-up: `service=gateway level=error | message contains "handshake timeout" | json` and `service=auth | duration>500ms | group_by upstream_host`.
support-ops: closing loop with customer: offered config + infra bump, they accepted and will monitor.
marta: assigning postmortem owner: @marta. Will collect timeline, config diffs, and proposed mitigations. Thanks everyone — great coordination. :white_check_mark:
